article.story: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- — Gavin Doty scored a season-best 18 points, Mark Morano added 16 and Syracuse rolled to a 102-49 victory over Central Connecticut State on Thursday night. Doty and Morano combined for seven of Syracuse's nine 3-pointers. Luke Wilson and Kiyan Anthony added 14 points apiece for Syracuse (2-0). Sadiq White Jr. matched a career-best with 10 rebounds to go with eight points. Four others scored eight points each for the Orange, which finished 38-of-59 shooting (64%) from the floor. Raphel Laurent scored 17 points for Central Connecticut (0-2). A 12-0 surge about midway through the first half gave Syracuse a double-digit lead on its way to a 47-23 lead at the break. The Orange shot 59% (17 of 29) from the floor and made 10 of 13 from the free-throw line in the half. After Laurent scored the first basket of the second half, Syracuse scored 11 straight points, capped by a Morano 3-pointer, and cruised from there. The teams have met once before, with Syracuse winning 96-62 during the 2012-13 season. Up next Central Connecticut: At Dartmouth on Sunday.
